name: cloudflare-zone
description: A DNS zone's records and settings: authoritative but delete-gated over records, forward-only over settings; creates the zone itself on opt-in
instructions: Reads the Cloudflare API through `../cloudflare-api`; needs a token with Zone Read (to look the zone up) and DNS Write on the zone, plus Zone Settings Read and Write if the instance declares `settings` (the module reads a setting before it patches one), plus, if it sets `createIfAbsent`, Zone Write across the account on a token minted with no `zones` restriction (a zone-scoped `cloudflare-token` cannot be minted for a zone that does not exist yet; narrow it once the zone does). With `createIfAbsent: true` an absent zone is created (type full) in the declared account; every apply prints the zone's nameservers and status, which is what the registrar must be pointed at. Authoritative over the record types it declares: a record present in Cloudflare and absent here is reported, and deleting it takes an explicit opt-in, because a zone is the one place where converging by deletion can take a domain off the internet between two applies. The `settings` key converges zone-level settings (`always_use_https`, `ssl`, `min_tls_version`, `automatic_https_rewrites`) forward-only: what is declared is converged, what is not declared is never read or touched.
